```{r}
#| label: setup
library(targets)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tsibble)

placeholder <- tar_read(using_placeholder)
kpis <- tar_read(kpis)
crossing <- tar_read(crossing)
gap <- tar_read(gap)
totals <- tar_read(totals)

comma <- scales::label_comma()
millions <- scales::label_number(accuracy = 0.01, scale = 1e-6, suffix = "M")
pct <- scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)

actual_col <- "#1f2937"; cf_col <- "#9ca3af"; naive_col <- "#d97706"; inter_col <- "#2563eb"; recent_col <- "#059669"

theme_dash <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_blank(), plot.title.position = "plot")

hist_df <- totals |> transmute(date = as.Date(date), arrivals)

# Phone-friendly plotly: no floating toolbar (it covered the legends on small
# screens) and legends placed under the chart instead of on top of it
tidy_plotly <- function(p, legend = TRUE, ...) {
  ggplotly(p, ...) |>
    plotly::layout(showlegend = legend,
                   legend = list(orientation = "h", x = 0, y = -0.22, xanchor = "left", yanchor = "top"),
                   margin = list(l = 10, r = 10, t = 30, b = 10)) |>
    plotly::config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: banner
#| output: asis
if (placeholder) {
  cat('::: {.callout-warning}\n**Placeholder data.** These charts use a SYNTHETIC series so the pipeline can be tested. They are not Department of Tourism figures. Add the DOT yearly files to `data/raw/` and rerun `targets::tar_make()`.\n:::\n')
} else {
  cat(sprintf('Source: Department of Tourism, Philippine Tourism Data Dashboard (CC BY 4.0). Monthly visitor arrivals, January 2010 to %s.\n', format(as.Date(tsibble::yearmonth(kpis$latest_month)), "%B %Y")))
}
```

## KPIs {height="20%"}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr 'paste0("Arrivals, Jan-", sub("^([0-9]{4}) (.*)$", "\\2 \\1", kpis$latest_month))'
list(icon = "airplane", color = "primary", value = millions(kpis$ytd))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Year to date vs same months of 2019"
list(icon = "percent", color = if (kpis$ytd_pct_2019 >= 1) "success" else "warning",
     value = pct(kpis$ytd_pct_2019))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Last 12 months vs full-year 2019"
list(icon = "calendar3", color = if (kpis$rolling12_pct_2019 >= 1) "success" else "warning",
     value = pct(kpis$rolling12_pct_2019))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: !expr 'paste0("Chance 12-month arrivals pass 2019 (", millions(crossing$target_2019_total), ") by ", sub(" .*", "", crossing$horizon))'
value <- if (crossing$already_passed) "Passed" else pct(crossing$prob_by_horizon)
list(icon = "graph-up-arrow", color = "info", value = value)
```

## Gap and models {height="45%"}

### Recovery gap {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: !expr 'sprintf("Actual vs no-COVID counterfactual. Visitors lost since Mar 2020: about %s (95%% interval %s to %s)", millions(gap$deficit_median), millions(gap$deficit_lo95), millions(gap$deficit_hi95))'
cf <- tar_read(cf_summary) |> mutate(date = as.Date(date))
p <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(data = cf, aes(as.Date(date), ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = cf_col, alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(data = cf, aes(date, median, colour = "Counterfactual (no COVID)"), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_line(data = hist_df, aes(date, arrivals, colour = "Actual")) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("Actual" = actual_col, "Counterfactual (no COVID)" = cf_col)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = as.Date(c("2015-01-01", NA))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Arrivals per month", colour = NULL) +
  theme_dash
tidy_plotly(p)
```

### Model comparison {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Three forecasts to 2030: naive Prophet, intervention ARIMA, and the headline post-reopening ARIMA (green), which wins the 12-month hold-out test. 80%/95% intervals, clipped at 2x the record month"
# The naive model's intervals explode; clip all bands at 2x the record month
# so the three panels stay readable (stated in the title)
cap <- 2 * max(hist_df$arrivals, na.rm = TRUE)
fc <- bind_rows(tar_read(naive_fc), tar_read(inter_fc), tar_read(recent_fc)) |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date), model = factor(model, levels = unique(model)),
         across(c(median, lo80, hi80, lo95, hi95), ~ pmin(.x, cap)))
short <- c("Naive Prophet" = "Naive", "Intervention ARIMA" = "Interv.",
           "Post-reopening ARIMA" = "Headline")
fc <- fc |> mutate(model = factor(dplyr::recode(as.character(model), !!!short),
                                  levels = unname(short)))
cols <- setNames(c(naive_col, inter_col, recent_col), levels(fc$model))
p <- ggplot(fc, aes(date)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95, fill = model), alpha = 0.15) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo80, ymax = hi80, fill = model), alpha = 0.25) +
  geom_line(aes(y = median, colour = model)) +
  geom_line(data = hist_df |> filter(date >= as.Date("2017-01-01")),
            aes(date, arrivals), colour = actual_col) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = kpis$total_2019 / 12, linetype = "dotted", colour = actual_col) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cols) + scale_fill_manual(values = cols) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1e-3, suffix = "k")) +
  scale_x_date(breaks = as.Date("2025-01-01"), date_labels = "%Y") +
  facet_wrap(~model, ncol = 3) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Arrivals per month") +
  theme_dash + theme(legend.position = "none")
tidy_plotly(p, legend = FALSE)
```

## Seasonality and markets {height="35%"}

### Seasonality {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Has the seasonal pattern returned? (month vs its year's average)"
s <- tar_read(seasonal)
p <- ggplot(s, aes(month, index, group = period, colour = period)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:12, labels = substr(month.abb, 1, 1)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "grey80") +
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = period == "2017-2019 average")) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1.4, `FALSE` = 0.6), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("2017-2019 average" = actual_col,
                                 setNames(scales::hue_pal()(n_distinct(s$period) - 1),
                                          setdiff(unique(s$period), "2017-2019 average")))) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Index (1 = avg month)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_dash
tidy_plotly(p)
```

### Source markets {width="50%"}

```{r}
#| title: "Top 10 markets of 2019: arrivals as a share of 2019 (2019 by residence and includes non-resident Filipinos; 2022+ by citizenship, excludes them)"
mr <- tar_read(market_rec)
p <- ggplot(mr, aes(recovery, reorder(market, recovery),
                    text = paste0(market, ": ", comma(latest), " vs ", comma(base), " (", pct(recovery), ")"))) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = recovery >= 1), width = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "#059669", `FALSE` = naive_col), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = pct) +
  labs(x = mr$period[1], y = NULL) +
  theme_dash
tidy_plotly(p, legend = FALSE, tooltip = "text")
```
